audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls his Q 'Infected Cleaver' (real name: Infected Bonesaw) and states three times that Parrrley out-ranges it. It does not — Bonesaw is 975 range, Parrrley is 625.
audit.why: Riot's ranges: Infected Bonesaw 975, Parrrley 625. He out-ranges you by 350 units, so the level-1 advantage is his regen not having ramped yet, not a range advantage. Getting this backwards tells the reader they can safely stand at Parrrley range and trade poke, which loses the exchange every time. Riot's Bonesaw text is also 'damage based on their current health', not missing health.
audit.corrected: Fixed the name to Infected Bonesaw everywhere I touched, replaced the false range claim with the real 975-vs-625 comparison, and re-stated the level-1 edge as his regen not being online yet.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Gangplank level 6 and Dr. Mundo the 2-item row; the packet chart and the mirror audit both say level 6 is Skill and 2+ items is Gangplank.
audit.why: whys[4] says Cannon Barrage does not win the 1v1 against a drain-tank and 'the stage nets out even' — that is Skill, not Gangplank. whys[6] and the late section say the Sheen/keg chain finally bursts past his regen at two items — that is yours. The drmundo-side audit has already published Level 6 Skill, First item Dr. Mundo, 2+ items Gangplank.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = Skill, 2+ items = Gangplank in both layers, ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes says 'Dr. Mundo: Heart Zapper online, level 6, first item' with no cooldowns, and phases[4].why is boilerplate.
audit.why: His spikes are Heart Zapper ranks (17s at rank 1, healing off the end-of-duration burst) through levels 3-5, and Maximum Dosage at 6 (120s, instantly heals a share of missing health then regenerates over a long duration). Yours is 2+ items with Sheen, where one chained detonation out-paces the regen — but only if his R is down.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states Cannon Barrage's 160s global does not out-duel a drain-tank; dontsFull[0].d names Maximum Dosage and its 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers and described Heart Zapper as 'his sustain + reset'.
audit.why: Heart Zapper 17s at rank 1, 325 radius, and it only heals if the end burst hits an enemy — stepping outside that radius before it pops denies the heal outright. Infected Bonesaw 4s. Maximum Dosage 120s. Remove Scurvy 22s.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the four numbers and the step-out-of-the-burst rule stated in report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer mentions his passive at all.
audit.why: Goes Where He Pleases resists the first immobilizing effect that hits him and drops a cannister he can walk over to heal and shorten the passive's cooldown — so your first piece of CC in a fight is absorbed and partly refunded as healing.

edits.before: Mundo is one of the few melees you actually out-stat at level 1 — Parrrley out-ranges his Infected Cleaver, so chip him and drop a barrel before his passive regen ramps. The catch: his Q is percent-HP poke that ignores your low durability, and from level 3 his Q-spam plus passive heal out-sustains your single-keg chip. Don't trade autos into him, and never set up a slow barrel he can just walk up and free-hit to deny the detonation — bait his cleaver, then last-hit safely with Q.
edits.after: Mundo is one of the few melees you out-stat at level 1, but not on range — Infected Bonesaw reaches 975 to your Parrrley's 625, so you eat chip while you farm. Chip back and drop a barrel before his regen ramps. From level 3 his 4s Bonesaw plus Heart Zapper's healing end-burst out-sustains your single-keg chip. Don't trade autos, and never leave a barrel he can walk up and free-hit to deny the detonation — bait the Bonesaw, then last-hit with Parrrley.
